edit.label: fullPath
edit.description: Full path will be calculated by system

edit.label: Badge
edit.description: Optional badge above section header (e.g., 'Newsletter', 'Stay Updated')

edit.label: Section Header
edit.description: Main section header with heading and description (use this OR custom heading below, not both)

edit.label: Newsletter Form Heading
edit.description: Custom heading for newsletter form (leave empty if using Section Header above). For two-tone: this is the second part (non-accented)

edit.label: Heading Accent Text
edit.description: First part of heading for two-tone style (appears in theme color). Only used when Text Style is set to 'two-tone'

edit.label: Heading Text Style
edit.description: Apply gradient or two-tone styling to newsletter form heading. Leave empty for default solid color

edit.label: Newsletter Form Description
edit.description: Description text below newsletter form heading

edit.label: Email Input Placeholder
edit.description: Placeholder text for email input field

edit.label: GDPR Link
edit.description: Link to privacy policy or terms (embedded in GDPR label)

edit.label: CTA Buttons
edit.description: Optional action buttons below newsletter form (max 2 buttons)

edit.label: Benefits List
edit.description: List of benefits/features (max 2 items). Shows below description
